note: WriteEventFlag (FM-A3 H022): the event-flag writer whose only caller is Cop09 (JSR $&). It belongs next to code_0064F8, the flag reader (FM-A3 section 6, placement 4.8). Both blocks are bank 0 and pinned, so the JSR $& stays legal. The target block becomes cop_core in W2-03.

BlockActorFootprint (FM-A3 H099): marks the tiles under an actor; its only caller is Cop15 (JSR $&). It belongs next to code_0065A7, which clears the footprint again (FM-A3 section 6, placement 4.8). Bank 0, pinned.

cop_core (placement 6.1): the helpers every COP handler shares, in their original ROM order (25715 to 26310, contiguous): CopB2 with the exit chain loc_0064B5 .. loc_0064C9 (entered by BRL from all other handlers, 124 BRL pairs stay cross-file by design), WriteEventFlag, the flag and inventory lookups, BlockActorFootprint, and the slot, footprint and spawn helpers (code_0065A7 .. code_0066A3). Bank 0, group system, pinned. Three block notes are joined (cop_handler_006473, engine_0064F8, engine_0065A7); PC rewrites them as one.

cop_dispatch (placement 6.1): the BRK vector handler (config nativeBrk, 22012) and the COP dispatcher with its three word tables (code_list_005638 ids 00-3C, cop_junk 3D-7F, code_list_005738 ids 80-B2), contiguous in ROM (22012 to 22430). The tables hold &Code words and are indexed by id*2 from one base, so they stay in one block in this order. Bank 0, group system, pinned. The block note of engine_00561E is kept.
